space.$description: Layer 1. 4px-based scale, named by pixel value so there is no scale position to memorize. Deliberately identical to Tailwind's default numeric spacing scale (space.16 is p-4), so the utility classes already in the codebase are on-system and do not need rewriting. These exist so CSS written outside Tailwind resolves to the same numbers.

radius.$description: Layer 1. 6 is the workhorse: a button, an input, a menu item and a card all use it unless there is a reason otherwise. 2 and 4 are for things nested inside something already rounded. 12 and 16 are for full-bleed panels only. Needing a value that is not on this list usually means the element is the wrong size.
